statement: For every n≥5, M2(n)≥8·2^((n−5) mod 19)·(611930960/8)^floor((n−5)/19). Here M2(n) is the maximum generic complex planar count, with reflected solutions distinct. The twenty-four-vertex building block has 611,930,960 realizations and a five-vertex subgraph with eight realizations. The resulting exponential growth base is approximately 2.59972.

source.location: Theorem 5 and the immediately preceding encoded 24-vertex graph (printed p.5; PDF index 4)

notes:
A maximum over graphs of generic complex counts; not a bound on maximum real realizations. Reflections are distinct.
